title: Congruence conjectures for permanents of shifted difference matrices
source: Han Wang and Zhi-Wei Sun, “Evaluations of some Toeplitz-type determinants”, arXiv:2206.12317 (2023). (https://arxiv.org/abs/2206.12317)

lanes.final_paper_check: final-paper-check-349250-355132-opus-20261118-r1/CHECK-355132.md (Claude Opus 5.5, PASS WITH EDITORIAL EDITS; revised paper used)

significance.root_decision: Let B_n be the n by n integer matrix with entries j - k + delta_jk. For every prime p, per(B_{p-1}) is congruent to 3 modulo p, and for every odd prime p, per(B_p) is congruent to 1 + 4p modulo p^2. These are the two permanent congruences conjectured by Wang and Sun. The modulo p^2 congruence uses a new reflection lifting lemma and a telescoping factorial sum.
significance.caveat: Zhi-Wei Sun's 2021 Chinese-language book, cited by the source as motivation (Conjecture 11.23), is unread.
